lines: Rahul Bahri may sell up to 1,800 shares in the offer for sale, bringing up to ₹0.24 crore, if all offered shares are sold.
Gain is up to ₹0.18 crore before offer expenses and taxes; employee-portion shares sell at a discount, so proceeds are slightly lower.
Money has been in hand since 11 Mar 2026 (8 months ago). The trigger is recent: shares unlocked 66 days ago, though these are shares, not cash.
Retained stake is an estimate of ₹0.57 crore at offer price. Confidence is medium: holdings appear in one section only.
